title: Architecture: sliced-implement-phase cleanup — context-PR topology collapse, restart hardening, dead-code purge
summary: Cleanup of the sliced implementation phase across two sequential slices, per cq-1: slice-1 ("A+D") collapses the egg/<id>/context branch onto egg/<id>/work, deletes the PR phase entirely (cq-4), opens the context PR up-front at the plan→implement boundary as a single hard-required idempotent gh-pr-list+create, hard-removes the redundant context_branch/context_title/context_description PRMetadata fields with a v1.1→v1.2 schema bump (cq-2), deletes orchestrator/consensus.py entirely (cq-5), subsumes the #2389 umbrella terminology rename as a structural deletion (cq-6), adds gh-pr-list idempotency to create_slice_pr (cq-8), keeps the speculative #2199 SliceScheduler hooks with noqa+docs (cq-3), bundles #2570 (silent work-branch rebase onto main) by stopping the rebase and adding an isolation invariant test, audits the 20 BLE001 swallow-all handlers individually (feedback Q2), collapses the 9 except-ImportError dual-path import shims to canonical orchestrator.X imports (feedback Q3), and does surgical structural extractions (_is_slice_dag_mode + slice-1 base resolution helper per cq-10). Slice-2 ("C") hardens slice and phase restart: eager-persists parent_branch_at_creation under the contract lock at PENDING→IN_PROGRESS plus a merge-base fallback (cq-9), iterates per-slice consensus trackers on restart_phase, and adds slice_id-tagged message-store reconstruction in startup_reconciliation (bundling #2409). Scope is explicitly bounded: #2792 / plan_draft_missing_on_local / _sync_worktree_with_remote / _empty_contract_hitl_* / PlanDraftMissingOnLocalError-family / _populate_contract_from_plan_safe are OUT OF SCOPE per operator directive on decision-11 and cq-7, and #2627 is OUT (sibling #2792 case) per feedback Q1.
v2_change_log: First architect output for #2777 plan phase; no v1 to diff against.

operator_directives_acknowledged.decision_11: #2792 / plan_draft_missing_on_local / plan→implement reconciliation is OUT OF SCOPE. Goal 4 from the issue body MUST NOT be included in any slice. cq-7 answered out-of-scope. All #2792-coupled primitives listed in the refine Runtime-Primitive Inventory are excluded from both slices.
operator_directives_acknowledged.cq_1: Two slices with dependency — slice-1 = A+D+PR-phase-removal, then slice-2 = C (restart hardening). 2 PRs, sequential, slice-2 depends on slice-1 having landed so it can build on the collapsed work-branch topology.
operator_directives_acknowledged.cq_2: Hard-remove context_branch / context_title / context_description from PRMetadata. Bump schemaVersion 1.1 → 1.2. No deprecation, no migrator. Validates against feedback-Q5 "no in-flight pipelines" — clean break is safe.
operator_directives_acknowledged.cq_3: Keep all five SliceScheduler #2199 hooks (record_cycle, teardown_slice, respawn_slice, cancel_cascade, hitl_escalator param) with `# noqa: ARG002` / dead-code markers and a docstring pointer to #2199. ~120 lines of test-only code preserved against the day #2199 lands.
operator_directives_acknowledged.cq_4: DELETE THE PR PHASE ENTIRELY. Open egg/<id>/work → main up-front at the plan→implement boundary, hard-required (no soft-fail), idempotent (one `gh pr list --head egg/<id>/work --base main --state open` + maybe one `gh pr create`). Apply uniformly to monolithic and sliced pipelines. Delete _should_skip_pr_phase_auto_pr + its caller, the PR-phase route registration, _context_pr_events_emitted dedup set, soft-fail observability sinks. Shrink _maybe_open_base_pr_for_plan_to_implement to a non-soft-fail _open_context_pr_at_implement_start (or inline it). Slice PRs continue to be opened by create_slice_pr.
operator_directives_acknowledged.cq_5: Delete orchestrator/consensus.py entirely. Confirm no readers remain (grep ConsensusEvaluator across orchestrator/ and tests/), then remove the module and the restart-path clear() calls at pipelines.py:3279.
operator_directives_acknowledged.cq_6: Subsume #2389 — drop "umbrella" terminology as a structural deletion (NOT a rename). The terminal-slice-umbrella concept disappears with the context-PR collapse: program-level content lives on the work→main PR; per-slice PRs no longer carry an "umbrella rollup" block. Close #2389 with a reference to slice-1.
operator_directives_acknowledged.cq_8: Add `gh pr list --head <slice_branch> --base <parent> --state open` pre-flight in GatewayClient.create_slice_pr (orchestrator/gateway_client.py:1491). On hit, return the existing PR number without calling `gh pr create`. Same shape as the new context-PR idempotency.
operator_directives_acknowledged.cq_9: Both: tighten eager-persist of parent_branch_at_creation to fire at the moment the slice transitions PENDING→IN_PROGRESS under the per-pipeline state lock AND keep a merge-base fallback in the slice-1 base resolution helper. Correctness fix + defence-in-depth for legacy/orphaned slices.
operator_directives_acknowledged.cq_10: Surgical decomposition only: extract _is_slice_dag_mode helper to dedupe the three bare `slice_count > 1` sites (pipelines.py:8259, 15060, 15519), and extract the slice-1 base resolution that currently calls _resolve_slice_1_context_branch_from_contract into a module-level helper. Leave the rest of the ~900-line _run_implement_phase_slices decomposition to #2261.
operator_directives_acknowledged.feedback_Q1: Bundle #2570 (work branch silently rebased onto main) into slice-1 — diagnose the rebase trigger and stop it; add the isolation invariant test. Bundle #2409 (per-slice consensus tracker reconstruction) into slice-2 — adds slice_id field to message_store schema and threads through reconstruct_tracker_from_messages. EXCLUDE #2627 (it's a #2792 sibling case).
operator_directives_acknowledged.feedback_Q2: BLE001 handlers: audit each of the 20 sites individually. Replace with specific exception types where the call's failure modes are knowable; leave remaining sites with deliberate comments explaining what each catches. operator_directives_acknowledged.feedback_Q4: Integration test REQUIRED. End-to-end test exercising slice-DAG → context PR opens up-front → hard-required path. Also unit tests for the idempotency pre-flight (gh pr list hit / miss) and the hard-required failure semantics (raises rather than soft-fails). Verifies #2769 trigger is structurally fixed.
operator_directives_acknowledged.feedback_Q5: No in-flight pipelines must remain compatible — clean cutover. Validates the cq-2 hard-remove and cq-3 dead-code-marker choices. If active pipelines exist at deploy time, gate the deploy on their completion or cancellation.

recommended_approach.name: Two-slice sequential cleanup: A+D+PR-phase-removal → C (restart hardening)
recommended_approach.summary: Slice-1 lands the structural collapse (context-PR topology onto work, PR phase deletion, PRMetadata schema bump, umbrella terminology deletion, ConsensusEvaluator deletion, idempotency hardening for create_slice_pr, #2570 silent-rebase fix, BLE001 audit, ImportError shim collapse, surgical _is_slice_dag_mode + slice-1 base resolution extraction). Slice-2 lands the restart hardening (eager-persist parent_branch_at_creation + merge-base fallback, per-slice consensus tracker reconstruction with slice_id-tagged messages bundling #2409, slice-aware restart_phase that iterates per-slice trackers). Sequential because slice-2's restart hardening reasons about the post-collapse topology — the moment slice-1 ships, slice-2 no longer has to consider the separate egg/<id>/context branch in its reconciliation logic.
why_recommended: Issue explicitly favours deletion; cq-1 chose the two-slice sequential shape with A+D bundled because most dead-code (D) services the context-PR scaffold (A); splitting them creates merge conflicts.

Three prior iterations (#2593, #2744, #2769) of symptom-fix-only on the context-PR class did not converge. The cleanup makes the design idempotent-by-construction: one gh-pr-list + one gh-pr-create at the plan→implement boundary, hard-required, replaces the soft-fail wrapper called from five sites.

The PR phase deletion (cq-4) is structurally cleaner than the original "backstop" framing — once the up-front open is atomic and hard-required, there is no silent-failure path to back-stop, so the PR phase becomes dead weight. This also obviates the _should_skip_pr_phase_auto_pr branch that hid the slice-DAG case from the existing backstop.

Bundling #2570 into slice-1 is necessary, not optional: the new context-PR model is head=egg/<id>/work base=main, which means a silently-rebased work branch directly threatens the new design's isolation invariant. Diagnosing and stopping the rebase has to land alongside the topology change.

Slice-2 separated from slice-1 because the restart-hardening surface is bounded and self-contained (per-slice tracker reconstruction + parent_branch_at_creation timing) and benefits from landing after slice-1 simplifies the topology it has to reconcile.

components.name: #2570 silent-rebase diagnosis & fix
components.where: Investigation surface: `rebase_onto` calls in orchestrator/gateway_client.py (the slice-rebase path at orchestrator/routes/pipelines.py:12350-adjacent); the per-execution worktree spawn (the `egg-exec-<timestamp>/work` artifact named in #2570); any sync-with-main / restart_phase / complete_phase paths that touch the work branch. Fix surface: whichever site applies main → work auto-rebase.
components.responsibility: Phase 1 — diagnose: bisect the pipeline-state-refresh / branch-update / restart-phase / advance-phase paths to identify which one auto-rebases egg/<id>/work onto main. Hypotheses from #2570: (a) gateway_client.rebase_onto being called main→work somewhere; (b) per-execution worktree (`egg/egg-exec-<timestamp>/work`) doing its own integrate-with-main step that leaks back; (c) restart_phase / complete_phase including a sync-with-main step. Phase 2 — stop the rebase: make egg/<id>/work append-only from orchestrator's perspective; orchestrator-authored commits via _commit_statefiles_to_worktree stack on top; any "refresh with main" becomes an explicit `merge --no-ff main` (preserves SHAs of incoming commits) or is removed entirely. Phase 3 — invariant test: assert merge-base(origin/main, egg/<id>/work) == pipeline-creation-time merge-base after N phases run with M main PRs merged in parallel. Slice rebase strategy: per #2570 suggestion 3, the slice-N branch's base is work (GitHub computes the diff at view time, no rebase required to update the PR); for stacked-PR cleanliness use `merge --ff-only` with a HITL on non-FF, not blind rebase.
components.evidence: Issue #2570 body. Refine feedback Q1 answer: "#2570 (work branch silently rebased onto main) directly threatens the new context PR = work→main model and must be addressed alongside the topology change — diagnose and stop the silent rebase as part of slice A." Concrete reproduction in #2570: `git merge-base origin/main origin/egg/issue-2548/work` returns `2e741c9b7` (creation-time tip); since then both branches gained the same logical PRs with different SHAs.
components.scope: trusted-CI / orchestrator + gateway. The rebase happens orchestrator-side (sync-with-main paths) and/or gateway-side (rebase_onto). Both pods may be involved.

technical_decisions.decision: Open the work→main context PR up-front at the plan→implement boundary (cq-4), not at PR-phase entry.
technical_decisions.rationale: The 'backstop' framing only existed because the original up-front open was a multi-step non-atomic operation that could silently fail (return None paths × 21). Once the open is one gh-pr-list + maybe one gh-pr-create — hard-required, no soft-fail — there is no silent-failure path to back-stop, so the PR phase is dead weight. Operator-directed in cq-4.
technical_decisions.alternatives_rejected: Backstop variants in cq-4's original three options (backstop opens only context PR / also re-verifies slice PRs / also reposts program-level body). All rejected because they keep the PR phase alive with non-trivial logic; operator chose deletion.

technical_decisions.decision: Hard-remove the three PRMetadata fields (cq-2 option 1) instead of deprecate-and-migrate.
technical_decisions.rationale: Operator feedback Q5 confirmed no in-flight pipelines must remain compatible. Hard removal is the cheapest path and avoids leaving deprecated fields in the model docs and v1.3-removal commitment.
technical_decisions.alternatives_rejected: Deprecate-with-comments + v1.3 follow-up (more code now + commitment to future change); contract migrator (moves complexity into the loader for negligible benefit when no in-flight pipelines exist).

technical_decisions.decision: Bundle #2570 (silent work-branch rebase) into slice-1 rather than as a follow-up.
technical_decisions.rationale: The new context PR's head is egg/<id>/work; a silently-rebased work branch creates duplicate-SHA commits on the PR's HEAD and breaks the diff. The bug directly contradicts the new model's invariant. Diagnose and stop must land alongside.
technical_decisions.alternatives_rejected: Defer #2570 as a follow-up (operator Q1 rejected — "directly threatens the new context PR = work→main model and must be addressed alongside the topology change").

technical_decisions.decision: Sequential two-slice DAG (cq-1 option 4) with slice-2 depending on slice-1.
technical_decisions.rationale: Slice-2's restart hardening reasons about the post-collapse topology. Letting slice-1 ship first means slice-2 designs against a clean model (no egg/<id>/context branch to reconcile, no PR-phase to consider in startup_reconciliation). Operator selected this shape in cq-1.
technical_decisions.alternatives_rejected: Four-parallel (cq-1 option 5: textual conflicts D↔A); three-parallel (option 3: B is out of scope); single-slice atomic (option 1: too large).

technical_decisions.decision: Audit BLE001 individually (Q2) instead of blanket SliceLoopRecoverableError.
technical_decisions.rationale: Per-site specificity matters — half the swallow-alls likely paper over now-knowable failure modes that should propagate. A blanket shim erases that information. Operator Q2 confirmed.
technical_decisions.alternatives_rejected: Leave alone (preserves third-party flakiness tolerance but accretes maintenance); blanket SliceLoopRecoverableError (loses per-site specificity).

technical_decisions.decision: Both eager-persist parent_branch_at_creation AND merge-base fallback (cq-9 option 3).
technical_decisions.rationale: Eager-persist closes the new-pipeline window; merge-base fallback provides defence-in-depth for legacy on-disk slices and orphaned cases. Combined cost is low (one moved write + one helper).
technical_decisions.alternatives_rejected: Eager-persist only (no recovery for legacy slices); merge-base only (the drift window stays open for new pipelines).

technical_decisions.decision: Subsume #2389 into slice-1 (cq-6) as structural deletion, not rename.
technical_decisions.rationale: The umbrella concept disappears entirely when the program-level content moves to the work→main PR. There is nothing left to rename — the call sites are deleted, not relabelled.
technical_decisions.alternatives_rejected: Leave #2389 independent (separate one-shot rename); split delete+cosmetic-rename.

technical_decisions.decision: Surgical decomposition only — _is_slice_dag_mode + slice-1 base resolution (cq-10).
technical_decisions.rationale: Issue explicitly favours deletion over refactor; aggressive decomposition of _run_implement_phase_slices is #2261's scope. Operator selected option 2.
technical_decisions.alternatives_rejected: Aggressive (cq-10 option 1, defer to #2261); defer all decomposition (cq-10 option 3 — still need _is_slice_dag_mode forced by the cq-4 PR-phase deletion).

risks_for_risk_analyst.summary: PR-phase deletion breaks any state-machine consumer that explicitly names 'pr' as a phase (dashboards, MCP responses, contract migrations, agent role configs).
risks_for_risk_analyst.blast_radius: Wide — touches MCP verb responses, possibly external observability.

risks_for_risk_analyst.summary: Schema v1.1 → v1.2 hard removal: any on-disk contract that wasn't migrated before deploy fails to load. Requires deploy-time validation that no v1.1 contracts remain.
risks_for_risk_analyst.blast_radius: Bounded by operator Q5 (no in-flight pipelines) but a regression here is loud and immediate.

risks_for_risk_analyst.summary: Hard-required _open_context_pr_at_implement_start: a transient gh outage at the plan→implement boundary now blocks the pipeline entirely (no soft-fail). The idempotency pre-flight makes a retry safe, but the caller must implement bounded retry-with-backoff before propagating the failure.
risks_for_risk_analyst.blast_radius: Medium — operator-visible failure under transient network conditions if not retried.

risks_for_risk_analyst.summary: Removing _CONTEXT_BRANCH_RE before verifying _PIPELINE_BRANCH_RE matches egg/<id>/work could break gateway pushes if the existing allow list relied on the context-branch exemption to cover work-branch pushes too.
risks_for_risk_analyst.blast_radius: Localized but breaks every pipeline-session push if missed.

risks_for_risk_analyst.summary: #2570 silent-rebase fix has unknown root cause until diagnosis lands. The diagnosis surface includes restart_phase / complete_phase / per-execution-worktree / gateway rebase_onto — any of which could be the trigger. Risk: phase-1 diagnosis goes long; planner should budget time.
risks_for_risk_analyst.blast_radius: Schedule-only; the fix itself is conservative (stop the rebase or convert to merge --no-ff).

risks_for_risk_analyst.summary: Message-store schema migration for slice_id field (#2409). If message_store persists to disk with a versioned schema, adding a field requires a migration path. Slice-2 must reuse or replicate the schema-evolution story for message_store.
risks_for_risk_analyst.blast_radius: Medium — could orphan in-flight signal messages from a pre-slice_id pipeline.

risks_for_risk_analyst.summary: Bootstrap reconciliation extension for non-COMPLETE slices: the new path preserves IN_PROGRESS / BLOCKED state. If reconstruction misjudges and the slice is actually stuck (no new commits expected), the orchestrator may wait forever instead of re-spawning. Need a 'is this slice actually making progress?' heuristic or an HITL escape valve.
risks_for_risk_analyst.blast_radius: Schedule + operator burden if false-positives accumulate.

risks_for_risk_analyst.summary: Umbrella-banner deletion (#2389) touches existing tests that assert the literal string. The test reshape is mechanical but if the program-level content move to the work→main PR is not symmetric, a regression test may pass when it shouldn't (e.g., asserting absence on per-slice PRs without asserting presence on the work→main PR).
risks_for_risk_analyst.blast_radius: Bounded — caught by Q4's integration test which asserts the work→main PR body assembly.

risks_for_risk_analyst.summary: BLE001 audit: replacing `except Exception` with named exceptions risks letting through an exception type that was unintentionally swallowed before. Per-site review is mandatory; the planner / coder should document the choice per site.
risks_for_risk_analyst.blast_radius: Slice-1 only; mitigated by per-site documentation in PR description and review.

risks_for_risk_analyst.summary: ImportError shim collapse: if any test runs in a flat-layout configuration (sys.path quirk, conftest manipulation), removing the fallback arm fails the test. Operator Q3 says 'verify by full test-suite run; if any test relies on the flat-layout form, revisit.' Risk: tests that DO rely on it surface late.
risks_for_risk_analyst.blast_radius: Bounded — make test-all reveals the issue; revert is one-line.

complexity_assessment.rationale: Slice-1 touches a load-bearing 23k-line orchestrator module (pipelines.py), the gateway pod (gateway.py), the contract schema (PRMetadata + schemaVersion), and several supporting modules. Five call sites collapse onto one new helper. The PR phase is excised from the pipeline state machine. The bundled #2570 fix has an unknown root cause requiring diagnosis. Slice-2 modifies the message_store schema (with a possible disk-migration concern) and reconstruction logic across signals.py / startup_reconciliation.py / peer_consensus.py. Both slices need new integration tests. Net-negative LOC (~600 lines deleted estimated, per refine analysis) but the deletion is in a fragile area with three prior iterations (#2593, #2744, #2769) that did not converge.
